title: 第3章 金手指现第4章 突破
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
秋日清晨，清风吹拂，带来丝丝凉意。
苍云门，演武场一角。
满一年的杂役弟子们按高矮顺序，排成一个方队，身姿挺拔。
每个人脸上都带着兴奋，就连平时成熟稳重的林潜，脸色也带着热切，目光直直的盯着台上那个身强力壮的大汉。
大汉穿着一身黑色劲装，古铜色的皮肤，目光锐利，盯着台下的杂役弟子，微微点头。
“我叫张翰，是传功堂的执事，你们可以叫我张执事也可以叫我张教头。”
“未来一个月就由我来传授大家武技，两个月内武技入门的可以成为外门弟子，超过两个月没入门的，说明没有练武天赋，只能继续做杂役。”
“好，废话不多说，今天传授大家的这门武技名字叫--通背拳。
这门武技传承悠久，攻防一体，拳掌相辅，力道沉猛，速度快捷，变化多端。
练到高深处能以一敌百。”
张执事平静的介绍这门武技。
“通背拳重中之重是“活腕”
，说白了就是手腕，把腕练活了，在日后练招式时很有利于把劲打出来，通背拳很重要的单操摔掌要打出劲来就主要靠腕的劲。”
张执事看大家稚嫩的小脸中皆是露出满脸希冀的光芒，继续讲到。
“今天先教大家如何“活腕”
有两个动作，一个抖腕，一个摇腕，通过这两个把手腕摇活，抖出劲来。
大家注意看我的动作，跟着练，有不懂的可以随时询问我。”
张执事讲解的很仔细，介绍了通背拳的基本情况，便开始演练了起来如何练习“活腕”
其余人都纷纷跟着练习。
张执事故意放慢了动作，摇腕就是以腕当车轴，顺时针逆时针的反复摇；抖腕时，手掌放松的抖两下而第三下时要突然握拳一抖，给人一种由松到紧，由柔到刚的感觉。

林潜也在专心致志的跟着练习，从生疏到熟悉，虽然并不标准，但也虚有其表了。
大家都学的有模有样，但是好多都是徒有其表摆了，甚至还有人用力过猛，把手腕摇脱臼了。
练习抖腕时，没有很重视，松松垮垮的，时不时抖一下，动作看似很标准，但是没有用上劲。
林潜找张执事请教了“活腕”
的疑难之处，才明白“活腕”
不只是动作做的标准就行了。
还得长期坚持练习，当成一种习惯，并得带劲练，不然后续学了通臂拳的招式，确发挥不出威力来，那就真成了花架子，纸老虎了，贻笑大方。
天色渐渐暗淡。
“要想在武道上有所成就，天赋是其中之一，另外勤奋也是必不可少的，二者缺一不可。
两个月后通背拳能否入门全靠你们自己的努力程度。”
张执事说完，便让大家各自回去休息。
......
水井旁，林潜坐在一张木凳上。
用冰凉井水浸湿毛巾，冰敷双腕，第一次练的太猛，双腕疼痛酸涩。
他不敢继续练，这个世界医疗水平好像不高，真练废了，要想治好可不容易。
刚回到房间，许阳就一脸兴冲冲的道：“潜哥，咱们终于学到武技了，出人头地的日子快到了。”
说完许阳双腕时不时抖一下，只是抖的有气无力。
“别高兴太早，两个月我们通臂拳没有入门，只能继续做杂役。”
林潜看到许阳一脸兴奋打击道。
“是啊，现在时间还早呢，两个月内我一定要入门，村里人都说我是练武的料。”
content_en:
In the early morning of autumn, the breeze blows, bringing a bit of coolness.
Cangyun Gate, a corner of the martial arts arena.
The handyman disciples who have completed one year are arranged in a square formation in order of height, with tall and straight postures.
Everyone had excitement on their faces. Even Lin Qian, who was usually mature and steady, had an eager expression on his face, staring straight at the strong man on the stage.
The big man wore a black suit, with bronze skin and sharp eyes. He stared at the handyman disciples in the audience and nodded slightly.
"My name is Zhang Han, and I am the deacon of Chuangong Hall. You can call me Deacon Zhang or Coach Zhang."
"In the next month, I will teach everyone martial arts. Those who have learned martial arts within two months can become outer disciples. Those who have not learned martial arts for more than two months mean that they have no talent for martial arts and can only continue to work as handymen."
"Okay, without further ado, the name of the martial art I will teach you today is Tongbei Fist.
This martial art has a long history, integrating offense and defense, complementing each other with fists and palms, strong force, fast speed, and many changes.
When you practice to a high level, you can defeat one against a hundred. "
Deacon Zhang introduced this martial art calmly.
"The most important thing in Tongbei Quan is the "living wrist"
, to put it bluntly, it is the wrist. If you practice the wrist, it will be very helpful to produce strength when practicing moves in the future. To produce strength in the single exercise of Tongbei Quan, Throwing Palm, it mainly relies on the strength of the wrist. "
Deacon Zhang saw that everyone's young faces were full of hope and continued to talk.
"Today I will teach you how to "live your wrist"
There are two movements, one is shaking the wrist and the other is shaking the wrist. Through these two movements, the wrist is shaken alive and the energy is exerted.
Please pay attention to my movements and practice along with me. If you don’t understand anything, you can ask me at any time. "
Deacon Zhang explained very carefully, introduced the basic situation of Tongbei Quan, and then began to practice how to practice "living wrist"
The others all followed suit.
Deacon Zhang deliberately slowed down his movements. When shaking his wrists, he used his wrists as axles and shook them clockwise and counterclockwise repeatedly. When shaking his wrists, he relaxed his palms twice and then suddenly clenched his fists for the third time, giving people a feeling of going from loose to tight, from soft to hard.
Lin Qian was also following the practice attentively, going from unfamiliar to familiar. Although it was not standard, it was superficial.
Everyone learned it in a decent way, but many of them were just showing off, and some even used too much force and dislocated their wrists.
When practicing wrist shaking, I didn't pay much attention to it. It was loose and fluffy, and I shook it from time to time. The movement seemed to be standard, but I didn't use much energy.
Lin Qian asked Deacon Zhang for advice on "live wrist"
Only when you understand the difficulties can you understand the "live wrist"
It’s not just about the standard movements.
You have to keep practicing for a long time, treat it as a habit, and practice vigorously. Otherwise, if you continue to learn the moves of the through-arm boxing and really cannot exert its power, then it will really become a showpiece, a paper tiger, and make people laugh.
The sky is getting dark.
“If you want to achieve success in martial arts, talent is one of them, and hard work is also essential. Both are indispensable.
Whether you can get started with Tongbei Quan after two months depends entirely on your own efforts. "
After Deacon Zhang finished speaking, he asked everyone to go back and rest.
...
Next to the well, Lin Qian was sitting on a wooden bench.
Wet a towel with cold well water and apply ice to both wrists. The first time I practiced too hard, my wrists were sore and sore.
He didn't dare to continue practicing. The medical level in this world seemed not to be high, and it would not be easy to cure him if he was really exhausted from practice.
As soon as he returned to the room, Xu Yang said happily: "Brother Qian, we have finally learned martial arts. The day to stand out is coming soon."
After saying this, Xu Yang's wrists shook from time to time, but only weakly.
"Don't be too happy too early. We haven't learned Tongjiquan in two months, so we can only continue to do odd jobs."
Lin Qian saw Xu Yang's excited expression and said.
"Yeah, it's still early now. I must get started within two months. People in the village say I'm good at martial arts training."
